oneLine: Sazerac acquires John Distilleries valuing it at Rs 4500 crore, founder Paul John retains stake

sources.title: Paul John may retain 10-20% stake in John Distilleries after Sazerac takeover

synopsis: US spirits group Sazerac took control of John Distilleries by increasing its holding to 65.7% in the financial year ended March 2026, up from 34.4% a year earlier. Paul John Fund LLC's stake declined from 65.6% to 34.3%. Founder Paul John is considering retaining a minority stake of 10% to 20% and may stay on in an advisory role. John Distilleries is valued at about 4,500 crore rupees. The company reported revenue from operations of 10,820 crore rupees for FY26 and a net profit of 11.6 crore rupees. The deal highlights Sazerac's expansion in the Indian market for premium spirits, though higher state duties in regions like Karnataka pose ongoing challenges to retail consumption.
